title: Radiofrequency ablation versus ethanol injection for early hepatocellular carcinoma: A randomized controlled trial
abstract: A randomized trial compared RFA and PEI for early non-surgical HCC in cirrhotic patients.

title: Screening for hepatocellular carcinoma: why, when, how?
abstract: This review and editorial discusses screening for HCC in cirrhosis. No trial was conducted.

title: Primary liver tumors
abstract: Many improvements have been made in the treatment of primary liver tumors, especially HCC. Partial hepatectomy remains the mainstay of therapy. This article discusses options but is not a randomized trial.

title: Randomized trial of metuximab after radiofrequency ablation in hepatocellular carcinoma
abstract: A randomized controlled trial of RFA plus metuximab versus RFA alone in BCLC 0-B HCC.
